title: Sandmaw
html:
This quest is not fully written yet. Steps, items or dialogue may be missing.Sandmaw, the old rock scorpion of the Scorpion Pits, stung Layla Barthrone's son, and her antivenom won't touch it.

About

Given byLayla Barthrone
Level29
LengthLong
KindSide
Quest points1

What you need

  • Scorpion Stinger ×10
  • Sedges Antivenom ×1
  • Sandmaws Stinger ×1

Steps

  1. Talk to Layla Barthrone (outdoors near Agauton) to get the quest.
  2. Bring Layla Barthrone 10 scorpion stingers (10) - Scorpion Stinger at 1194, 242
  3. Kill Sandmaw at 975, 616
    Bring Mother Sedge Sandmaw's stinger - Sandmaws Stinger at 98, 388
  4. Bring Layla Barthrone Mother Sedge's antivenom - Sedges Antivenom at 1196, 242
  5. Bring Layla Barthrone 10 scorpion stingers (10) - Scorpion Stinger at 1205, 242

Rewards

Reward
Gold4,290
Character XP134,000
Quest points1
ItemsSedges Antivenom

What Layla Barthrone says

Layla Barthrone: I'll get these on the fire now. No, look at the color. It's the same as the last batch, and the last batch did nothing.

Layla Barthrone: Sandmaw's poison is not like the young ones'. My mother used to say only Mother Sedge in Windthorne could cure an old one's sting, and she needed the old one's own sting to do it.

Layla Barthrone: Kill Sandmaw and take his stinger to Sedge. Please be quick.

Mother Sedge: The Barthrone boy? I heard. Give it here, and mind the barb.

Mother Sedge: An old one's poison is his own. Nothing touches it but what's in his sting. Sit down and don't touch anything.

Mother Sedge: There. One flask, and that's all there is. Get it to Agauton. Half now and half at sundown, tell her.

Layla Barthrone: Half now and half at sundown. I'll sit with him.

Layla Barthrone: If Sedge says this will do it, I believe her. Take this. It isn't enough for what you did, but it's what we have.

Handing it in

"If Sedge says this will do it, I believe her. Take this. It isn't enough for what you did, but it's what we have."

Sandmaw
